description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter component, testing its decision logic under various security modes, session states, and fallback scenarios.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompterTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test cases for ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter's decision logic.

methods.name: session match prefers active session
methods.description: Tests whether the Prompter correctly identifies a match when the active session matches the request session.

methods.name: session fallback uses recent activity
methods.description: Tests the fallback behavior based on recent activity timestamps when no active session is present.

methods.name: default behavior matches mode
methods.description: Ensures the default prompt behavior aligns with the specified mode (local or remote).

methods.name: askAlwaysPromptsRegardlessOfSecurity
methods.description: Checks that the 'always' ask setting prompts regardless of security level.

methods.name: askOnMissPromptsOnlyForAllowlist
methods.description: Verifies prompts are triggered only when security is allowlist and ask mode is 'onMiss'.

methods.name: askOffNeverPrompts
methods.description: Ensures no prompts are shown when ask mode is 'off' across different security levels.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistAllowsMatchingResolvedPath
methods.description: Tests whether allowlist patterns correctly permit execution when the resolved path matches.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistDeniesAllowlistMiss
methods.description: Ensures denial when the resolved path does not match the allowlist pattern.

methods.name: fallbackFullAllowsWhenPromptCannotBeShown
methods.description: Verifies fallback behavior allowing execution when prompts cannot be displayed.
